design_principles.atomicity_rule: Each skill should express one independently verifiable state transition and should not expose joint-level control.
design_principles.unmatched_policy: Return unresolved instead of inventing a skill or scene element.
design_principles.context_binding_policy: A task-level role keeps the same scene element binding across all dependent steps unless an explicit rebind operation is requested.

parameter_types.scene_element: An element_id that must exist in the ConceptGraphs scene graph.
parameter_types.location: A navigable place, room, waypoint, or pose grounded in the scene graph.
parameter_types.surface: A scene element with support_surface affordance.
parameter_types.container: A scene element with container affordance.
parameter_types.person: A person or recipient grounded in the scene graph.
parameter_types.control: A button, switch, handle, or other controllable scene element.
parameter_types.height_m: A numeric body or arm height in metres within robot limits.
parameter_types.number: A finite numeric value whose unit is defined by the parameter name.
parameter_types.vector_or_symbolic_direction: A normalized vector or a symbolic direction grounded in the robot or world frame.
parameter_types.semantic_content: A semantic content label such as water; it must be supported by observed or declared state.
parameter_types.semantic_property: The object state or property requested for inspection.
parameter_types.reference_frame: Identifier of a supplied, verified coordinate frame. Do not infer missing transforms.
parameter_types.hand_selector: Configured hand/manipulator identifier. Caller must resolve ambiguity and availability.
parameter_types.pose_reference: Reference to an explicitly supplied target pose including orientation. No invented coordinates.
parameter_types.state_reference: Reference to a calibrated initial configuration, not an assumed all-zero state.
parameter_types.component_selector: Explicit manipulation component identifier; the list does not define its reset scope.
parameter_types.contact_constraint_reference: Reference to supplied contact mode, force/torque limits and termination conditions.
parameter_types.trajectory_reference: Reference to a supplied direction/path/axis and displacement or angle, in a verified frame.

selection_order: Match subtask goal conditions against skill effects.
Check that every required skill parameter can be bound.
Check required affordances against scene-element attributes.
Check preconditions against the current or predicted state.
Prefer the shortest valid skill sequence; break ties deterministically by skill_id.

composite_task_templates.source_sequence_zh: 自由移位 → 建立抓持 → 抬起并搬运 → 受控接触托盘 → 受控释放
composite_task_templates.composition_notes: Resolve whether the tray is a support or container; do not assume in versus on.

composite_task_templates.source_sequence_zh: 自由移位 → 受控接触 → 约束平移到触发条件 → 撤回
composite_task_templates.composition_notes: Trigger feedback and a withdrawal trajectory must be supplied.

composite_task_templates.source_sequence_zh: 接近把手 → 建立抓持 → 沿滑轨约束平移 → 释放
composite_task_templates.composition_notes: Ground the handle, rail direction and release condition.

composite_task_templates.source_sequence_zh: 抓把手 → 必要时转动解锁 → 沿铰链约束旋转 → 释放
composite_task_templates.composition_notes: Unlocking is conditional; ground the hinge and lock state.

composite_task_templates.source_sequence_zh: 左手固定瓶身；右手抓盖 → 旋转 → 必要时换指并重复 → 分离后搬走
composite_task_templates.composition_notes: Requires two independently controlled hands; no fixed repeat count or torque is supplied.

composite_task_templates.source_sequence_zh: 抓持 → 必要时手内调姿 → 接近入口 → 局部搜索对准 → 约束平移 → 释放
composite_task_templates.composition_notes: Ground the opening, clearance, insertion axis and contact constraints.

composite_task_templates.name_zh: 拿工具按指定方向使用
composite_task_templates.source_sequence_zh: 功能部位抓持 → 手内调姿或重配置 → 接触目标 → 执行平移、旋转或贴面跟随
composite_task_templates.composition_notes: Select a task-appropriate contact primitive; the listed alternatives are not all mandatory.

composite_task_templates.source_sequence_zh: 抓住擦拭工具 → 接触桌面 → 贴面跟随并保持接触力 → 抬起 → 放回
composite_task_templates.composition_notes: Ground the tool, wiping path, contact force constraints and return location.

composite_task_templates.source_sequence_zh: 交出手保持 → 接收手接近并抓持 → 确认接收稳定 → 交出手释放
composite_task_templates.composition_notes: Requires two hands; transfer between hands is not handover to a person.

catalogue_policy.scope: Extensible, versioned skill options across platforms; not a controller capability assertion.
catalogue_policy.future_extension: Append reviewed definitions and semantic profiles without reusing existing IDs.
catalogue_policy.current_snapshot_closed_world: Only registered IDs may be proposed in a given run. This is not a permanent limit on future skills.
catalogue_policy.legacy_robot_profile_scope: robot_profile remains the original quadruped default; it does not certify new humanoid, two-hand or contact capabilities.
catalogue_policy.template_policy: Composite examples are stored separately; do not issue template IDs as atomic skill IDs.
catalogue_policy.runtime_boundary: The historical collection worker still selects five skills. Four-column matrices cannot encode all catalogue parameters. No executor or motion defaults are changed.
